page_title: PDF Pals — Native AI PDF Assistant for Mac

sources.entry: PDF Pals - Chat with PDF app for Mac. No file size limits!

summary.name: PDF Pals
summary.one_liner: PDF Pals is a native macOS AI assistant for chatting with one or more PDFs, summarizing them, and checking answers against cited source pages.
use_cases: Chatting with PDFs to get answers with source page references
Comparing findings across multiple PDFs for research
Reviewing contracts and legal case files
Learning from technical documentation and e-books
Extracting text from scanned PDFs with OCR
summary.what_it_does: PDF Pals lets you open one or multiple PDFs and ask questions in plain language, returning answers with references to the relevant source pages. It supports scanned PDFs and complex forms through a built-in OCR engine. Models can be local (Ollama and LM Studio are mentioned) or cloud models via the user's own API key for providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and OpenRouter. The page states documents stay on the Mac with no file upload or cloud vector database, and the library is stored in a local SQLite database. API keys are stored in the Apple Keychain.
notable: Native macOS app, explicitly not Electron, with no file size limit
Local models (Ollama, LM Studio) or own API keys; API keys kept in Apple Keychain
Documents and library stored locally in SQLite, with easy backup
Answers link back to cited source pages for verification
caveats: Mac-only; no Windows or Linux version is mentioned
Pricing is not stated on the page; cloud model use requires the user's own API key
Crash reports and analytics are optional, per the page
